criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Book Restaurant Reservation
categories.definition: Book a table or make a reservation at a dining establishment.

categories.name: Get Weather Information
categories.definition: Request current or forecasted weather conditions for a specific location or time.

categories.name: Get Movie Showtimes
categories.definition: Inquire about movie schedules, showtimes, or what films are currently playing at a cinema.

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: Initiate playback of music, audio, video, or launch a media application.

categories.name: Add to Playlist
categories.definition: Add a specific media item or artist to a designated playlist.

categories.name: Rate Media Content
categories.definition: Assign a rating or review to a piece of media or content.

categories.name: Find Media
categories.definition: Search for or retrieve information about a specific book, album, movie, TV show, game, or other creative work.

categories.name: Query Media Status
categories.definition: Inquire about the status or information related to a media item, such as cancellation or availability.
